subject: English
question_text: Fill in the gaps with appropriate preposition.
stimulus: Today man has been suffering (a) ______ various diseases. And there is no remedy (b) ______ most of these fatal diseases. So, he has to be careful (c) ______ health. One day all will depart (d) ______ this world. Here no man can live (e) ______ a long time.
guide_solution: Prepositions: (a) from (b) for (c) to (d) from (e) for
